description.subtitle: First-team T-shirt Joma del Brentford 2026 2028 - red, white
description.tagline: La esencia del Brentford en cada franja
description.intro: The Joma Brentford 26 28 T-shirt keeps alive the iconic red and white stripes that represent the history, identity and competitive character of the Bees. A classic design renewed with current technologies so that you enjoy the passion for Brentford both in the stadium and in the day to day.
key_benefits: Micro-Mesh System: Ventilation panels that improve moisture management.
Lightweight fabric: Promotes mobility and comfort during play.
Costuras Flatlock: Disminuyen las rozaduras y aumentan el confort.
Jacquard Finish: Integrates graphics into the fabric that improve breathability and design.
